units: 1 unit = 1 metre, Y up, models face +Z, pivots at the base, modular pieces snapped to 0.5 m

extents.note: 154 x 86 m. Deliberately small; density beats footprint.

layerContract.note: There is no 'Foliage' layer in this project. All foliage, cliff and town geometry goes on Environment; walkable decks on Ground; props the player can talk to on Interactable; zone/grass/water triggers on ZoneTrigger.

camera.kind: fixed three-quarter, 8-step yaw snapping, limited orbit
camera.note: At 42 deg pitch and 5.5 m the camera sits 3.68 m above and 4.09 m behind the player, and one screenful of ground is about 14 m across. Every 14 m of walkable path in this layout is given its own landmark and its own near-lens framing element, because that is the interval at which the player gets a new picture.

depthOfField.note: DOF only pays off if there is geometry at each depth. Foliage is deliberately planted 1.5-3.5 m off the path edge on BOTH sides so that whichever of the 8 yaw steps the camera snaps to, something sits in the foreground fringe.

terrain.note: THE KIT SHIPS NO TERRAIN AND NO WATER MESH. All 85 assets are props, foliage, modular cliff/riverbank pieces and buildings; there is no ground plane among them. These decks must be authored by the integrator (Unity Terrain, ProBuilder, or imported planes) before any placement below will sit on anything. Deck surfaces carry PokeLabTerrainBlend; water carries PokeLabWater.

heightFields.note: Placement Y values were sampled from these; reproduce them or the props will float or sink. Implemented in Tools/Level/build_layout.py.
heightFields.shore: grades from -1.5 at the waterline to 0.0 over an 8 m band; y = -1.5 + t*(1.5) + 0.12*sin(0.3x), t = clamp((d-21)/8), d = hypot(x+6, 1.15*(z+2))

decks.name: Deck_TownTerrace
decks.note: Cliff-edged on west and south; the cliff runs under Town/Terrain match it.

decks.name: Deck_RouteFloor
decks.note: Meets Deck_TownTerrace at the X=34 cliff and Deck_ShoreBand along its southern edge.

decks.name: Deck_ShoreBand
decks.note: A ring around the lake, 6-9 m wide, grading from -1.5 at the waterline to 0.0 where it meets Deck_RouteFloor. The seam is broken with scatter, not butted.

decks.name: Deck_CaveFloor
decks.note: The chamber floor, a void carved out of the massif mass. Ceiling deck at y=6.5 over the same polygon, facing down.

decks.name: Deck_MassifTier1Top
decks.note: Top of the massif's first ring. NOT walkable and NOT on the NavMesh -- it exists so the cliff modules based at 6.5 have ground under them and the mountain reads as a solid mass rather than a floating wall.

decks.name: Deck_MassifRidgeTop
decks.note: The skyline. Pure background silhouette; the DOF far band starts here.

ramps.grade: 20 deg -- inside the 48 deg slope limit

ramps.name: Ramp_LakeSpur
ramps.grade: graded bank, under 8 deg, punctuated by two 1 m ledges

ledges.name: Ledge_Spur_Upper

water.name: Water_Lake
water.note: Needs the opaque texture and depth texture on; see PokeLabWater.

water.name: Water_Outflow
water.note: The lake's outflow, ~4.5 m wide, running east off the map. Env_Bridge_Wood crosses it at (23.4, -7.5); that crossing carries the loop from the shore walk onto the east bank.

water.name: Water_CavePool
water.note: Still, dark, no wind. The one bright thing in the chamber.

waterfalls.name: Waterfall_Main
waterfalls.note: Env_Waterfall_Shelf provides the lip only. The falling sheet, the plunge ring and the foam are shader/VFX work -- not in the kit.

volumes.name: ZV_Cave_Mouth
